title: Change details on a high risk work licence
summary: Update details, including your address, contact information, or name, for your high risk work licence online.
intro:
If your address or contact details have changed, you can update your high risk work (HRW) licence online.

You can also register a change of name for your high risk work (HRW) licence.

See how to update a general construction card (white card) or traffic control work training card.
what_you_need: Your licence number (found at Verify NSW)
A certified copy of an Australian marriage certificate or an Australian change of name certificate (if changing your name)
A certified copy of any changes to your registered business or trading name certificate of registration (if changing your business or trading name)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your details.

faqs.q: How can I update my high risk work licence details?
faqs.a: You can update your high risk work (HRW) licence details online by selecting the 'Change online' button, then 'Start', and following the prompts.

faqs.q: What do I need to update my name on my high risk work licence?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your licence number (found at Verify NSW), and a certified copy of either an Australian marriage certificate or an Australian change of name certificate.

faqs.q: What do I need if I am changing my business or trading name?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your licence number, and a certified copy of any changes to your registered business or trading name certificate of registration.
